bio: Changes are afoot in the small world of SHIKI on Krugerstraße. Following the opening of the exclusive SHIKI Omakase, the concept of the main establishment has been refined. Japanese Fine Dining and Brasserie & Bar have now been merged into SHIKI Japanese Cuisine. The appealing menu ranges from outstanding, ultra-fresh sushi and premium steak cuts to the house's signature brasserie classics. This is complemented by an excellent wine list and superb cocktails.
